specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: The Creta for the Indian market is offered with three engine options, 1.5-litre petrol producing 115 PS (85 kW; 113 hp) and develops 144 N⋅m of torque and a 1.5-litre diesel engine with 115 PS and 250 N⋅m of torque as well as a turbocharged petrol.

specs.name: torque
specs.source_sentence: 1.5-litre petrol producing 115 PS and develops 144 N⋅m (15 kg⋅m; 106 lb⋅ft) of torque.

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: The Chinese model (codename: SU2c) is solely powered by the 1.5-litre petrol engine producing 115 PS (85 kW; 113 hp).

specs.name: diesel_torque
specs.source_sentence: a 1.5-litre diesel engine with 115 PS (85 kW; 113 hp) and 250 N⋅m (25 kg⋅m; 184 lb⋅ft) of torque.
